name: 员工信息总表
query: SELECT emp.employee_name AS "姓名:Data:160", emp.id_card_number_cn AS "身份证号:Data:160", emp.gender AS "性别:Data:80", edu.qualification AS "学历:Data:120", edu.school_univ AS "毕业院校:Data:180", edu.maj_opt_subj AS "专业:Data:140", emp.department AS "部门:Link/Department:160", emp.designation AS "岗位:Link/Designation:160", emp.status AS "状态:Data:90" FROM `tabEmployee` emp LEFT JOIN (SELECT e1.parent, e1.qualification, e1.school_univ, e1.maj_opt_subj FROM `tabEmployee Education` e1 INNER JOIN (SELECT parent, MAX(idx) AS max_idx FROM `tabEmployee Education` GROUP BY parent) e2 ON e1.parent = e2.parent AND e1.idx = e2.max_idx) edu ON edu.parent = emp.name ORDER BY emp.employee_name
